meta.homeDescription: Patrik Breeck builds iPhone apps, his own operating system and pixel creatures that live on your screen.
meta.appsDescription: Native iPhone apps Patrik Breeck builds under the name Ares: Aresium, Arestemis, Arestoteles and Aresus.

home.lead: I build iPhone apps, my own operating system and the little pixel creatures walking around this page.

projects.aresos: My own operating system: a Linux that boots into a Minecraft world, with the apps living in the game.
projects.apps: Four native iPhone apps in English and German, light and dark, with one account for all of them.
projects.companions: {count} pixel creatures for any screen, each with moves of its own. A few of them live on this page.

apps.title: Ares apps
apps.lead: Native iPhone apps I build under the name Ares. Each one speaks English and German, has a light and a dark look, and they all share one Ares account.
apps.state: Built and tested. They come to the iPhone via TestFlight as soon as Apple approves the developer account.
apps.requestNote: Requests go through the contact form for now. I approve each one and send a TestFlight invite.
apps.personalNote: It shows only my own data, so it stays mine.
